impact: The ZUG_REGISTER_TOKEN guard added in ISS-013 requires POST /register to include Authorization: Bearer <token>. claude.ai's dynamic client registration does not send this header — it posts the registration body directly per the base RFC 7591 spec. Setting ZUG_REGISTER_TOKEN renders the claude.ai web integration completely unusable. The existing registerClient redirect-URI allowlist (https://claude.ai/* only) is the only functional defense. ZUG_REGISTER_TOKEN is a security feature that cannot be used without breaking the product.
resolution: Removed the ZUG_REGISTER_TOKEN middleware from http.ts entirely. The feature required `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on POST /register per RFC 7591, but claude.ai's dynamic client registration does not send this header — making the feature incompatible with the product's only real use case. The registerClient redirect-URI allowlist in oauth-provider.ts (https://claude.ai/* only) remains as the sole registration guard and provides equivalent security without breaking claude.ai integration.
title: [bug] ZUG_REGISTER_TOKEN breaks claude.ai — RFC 7591 initial access token not supported by claude.ai client
